```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 08_hypothesis_testing_stating_hypotheses
title: >
  State a Pair of Hypotheses
questions:
  - id: own_hypotheses
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Save response
    answerLabel: Example answer
    prompt: >
      Come up with a psychological research question of your own. State a null
      and an alternative hypothesis for it, and decide whether the alternative
      should be directional.
    answer: >
      Research question: Does sleep deprivation affect memory? $H_0$: Sleep
      deprivation has no effect on the mean number of words people recall.
      $H_1$: Sleep deprivation changes the mean number of words people recall.
      This alternative is non-directional; I might predict that sleep
      deprivation makes recall worse, but an improvement would also be worth
      knowing about.
    explanation: >
      Check that your null states no effect, no difference, or no association,
      and that your alternative covers everything the null doesn't, so that
      one or the other must be true. If you made your alternative directional,
      ask yourself whether you'd really be willing to treat a result in the
      other direction, however extreme, as no evidence against the null.
```
